svg.title: Shift-Gated Conformal Abstention
svg.desc: Offline calibration constructs a false-alarm threshold and embedding reference; runtime uses a Mahalanobis conformal p-value to decide whether to support or withhold a forecast.

svg.text: SGCA: calibrate once, verify every decision
Shift-Gated Conformal Abstention separates “the score is high” from “this score is supportable here.”
The in-distribution statement depends on exchangeability. Under shift, the OOD p-value is a
conservative gating heuristic—not a new mathematical guarantee.
